notes: EPIC crop model coupled to a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm; decision variables are total N fertiliser amount/splitting and irrigation amount/scheduling (Table 2, p5). Neither is a defined practice: plain fertiliser rate increases are excluded under nutrient_mgmt_b (the business-as-usual pathway), and irrigation amount optimisation is not in the vocabulary. The paper does report modelled gross margin ('benefit', $/ha) along Pareto fronts in Figures 2-10, so it would otherwise pass the outcome criterion (data_type modelled). No rows extracted.
